conceptBlocks.text: 积压表示资金占用相对需求偏高；滞销表示观察期内无销售或销售极慢；缺货风险表示库存不足以覆盖预计需求。

items: 库存覆盖天数=期末数量÷期间日均销售出库量。
该指标描述按历史速度能卖多久，不等于实际售罄日期。

syntax.purpose: 库存积压、滞销与缺货预警的语法模板如下，各部分含义见下方说明。

problem: 主案例：2025-10-03至12-31共90天，按仓库商品计算毛销售出库数量（不扣退货），期末有效商品，库存成本价值严格大于500000分、销量严格小于20件。确认流水完整后无销售记0，零销量的覆盖天数为空。补充双向规则另用12-02至12-31共30天：销量至少30且可用量不足15日需求为缺货风险；销量不超过3且成本库存至少300000分为积压。示例假设快照数量等于可用量，实际须扣预留并按业务定义可售数量。

methodBlocks.text: s 按仓库商品汇总 sale 类型，数量取负号成为正销量；不要加退货或期外数据。库存快照以同仓同商品左接销售汇总，保留零销量商品。
主查询先限定有效状态与快照日，再用成本价值及销量阈值筛选。补充查询单独计算30日销量，不得把90日销量代入30日规则；缺货判断用数量比较 15×销量/30，避免除零。
补货阈值则来自商品自身，不是所有商品固定同一数量。

breakdown.title: 按仓库商品汇总期间出库量
breakdown.sql:
WITH s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-10-03' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id)
SELECT * FROM s ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 按仓库商品汇总期间出库量（s）的实际执行结果。
breakdown.reason: 在示例数据上运行该步骤，核对中间结果后再进入下一步。

completeCode.mysqlSql: WITH s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-10-03' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id) SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.quantity,COALESCE(s.sold,0) sold_units,i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents stock_value_cents,ROUND(90.0*i.quantity/NULLIF(s.sold,0),2) cover_days FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id WHERE p.active=1 AND i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents>500000 AND COALESCE(s.sold,0)<20 ORDER BY stock_value_cents DESC, product_name
completeCode.sqliteSql: WITH s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-10-03' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id) SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.quantity,COALESCE(s.sold,0) sold_units,i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents stock_value_cents,ROUND(90.0*i.quantity/NULLIF(s.sold,0),2) cover_days FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id WHERE p.active=1 AND i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents>500000 AND COALESCE(s.sold,0)<20 ORDER BY stock_value_cents DESC, product_name

resultBlocks.text: 主示例商品1库存价值600000分、销量10、覆盖900天；商品2价值560000分、销量0、覆盖天数空，仍是滞销候选。商品4虽然高库存但已停用，排除；
商品5价值400000分未达到90日规则。30日规则下商品3销量40、库存5，低于20件需求，属于缺货风险；商品1、2、5为积压候选。
原企业预览仓3商品339库存282件、90日销量9、覆盖2820天，需要核对季节备货、在途及数据完整性，不代表必然积压。

extensions.label: 小型示例：30日双向预警

explanationBlocks.text: 近30日销量和库存价值重新计算，商品3缺货。

extensions.sql:
WITH products(product_id,active,reorder_level) AS (SELECT 1,1,10 UNION ALL SELECT 2,1,5 UNION ALL SELECT 3,1,20 UNION ALL SELECT 4,0,5 UNION ALL SELECT 5,1,10),
inventory_snapshots(warehouse_id,product_id,snapshot_date,quantity,unit_cost_cents) AS (SELECT 1,1,'2025-12-31',100,6000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,'2025-12-31',70,8000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,3,'2025-12-31',5,1000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,4,'2025-12-31',100,9000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,5,'2025-12-31',50,8000),
stock_movements(warehouse_id,product_id,movement_type,movement_date,quantity_delta) AS (SELECT 1,1,'sale','2025-11-01',-10 UNION ALL SELECT 1,3,'sale','2025-12-10',-40 UNION ALL SELECT 1,4,'sale','2025-12-01',-1 UNION ALL SELECT 1,5,'sale','2025-12-03',-3 UNION ALL SELECT 1,1,'return','2025-12-20',2 UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,'sale','2025-10-01',-50),
s30 AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-12-02' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id)
SELECT i.product_id,COALESCE(s30.sold,0) sold30,i.quantity, i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents stock_value,CASE WHEN COALESCE(s30.sold,0)>=30 AND i.quantity<15.0*s30.sold/30 THEN '缺货风险' WHEN COALESCE(s30.sold,0)<=3 AND i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents>=300000 THEN '积压候选' ELSE '其他' END AS risk FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN s30 ON s30.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s30.product_id=i.product_id WHERE p.active=1 AND i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' ORDER BY quantity DESC;

comparison.text: 覆盖天数高不是充分证据，零销量也不是零天；不同观察期的规则不能混用。

example.text: 使用全公司销量匹配单仓库存，或者将无销量覆盖天数填0。

correction.text: 按仓库商品匹配并保留 NULL；分别计算90日和30日指标。
